units.title: Foundation and deterministic domain contracts
units.scope: Create repository governance, specification, shared PR contract, security inventory, exact-integer voting, numbering, amendment resolution, hashing and package exports. Include an accessible walkthrough demonstrator.
acceptanceCriteria: Three repositories validate the shared registry; the core rejects malformed ballots and stale language; public input cannot adopt text; artifacts make implementation limits explicit.
requiredTests: Run registry contract tests, adversarial domain tests, deterministic property campaigns and source-bound validation. No remote or deployment claim.

units.title: Identity, tenants and membership lifecycle
units.scope: Add OIDC/passkeys, secure sessions, verified accounts, tenant membership, invitations, device enrollment, recovery and step-up authentication; separate identity evidence from public profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Expired/revoked sessions fail everywhere; one tenant cannot inspect another; a login recovery cannot silently authorize an E2EE device.
requiredTests: Session fixation, recovery replay, CSRF, cross-tenant API and membership-revocation integration tests against disposable Postgres.

units.title: Private workspace endpoint encryption
units.scope: Implement a pinned upstream-compatible group and attachment encryption library at authorized clients, device verification, membership rekey, encrypted local cache, key backup and explicit recovery profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Storage, relays, exports, queues, backups and operator credentials contain no private plaintext or unwrapped application keys; group removal rotates future access; no custom cryptographic primitive.
requiredTests: Service-compromise canaries, malicious-device enrollment, key-change warnings, removed-member access, backup restore and protocol interoperability tests. Publish precise threat exclusions.

units.title: Semantic legal document schema
units.scope: Version stable document/block IDs, nested sections, definitions, citations, exhibits, tables, text marks, footnotes and separate presentation metadata. Define migrations and immutable published snapshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic IDs survive renumbering; unknown schema versions fail safely; migrations preserve meaning and audit lineage.
requiredTests: Golden document fixtures, malformed/deep tree fuzzing, migration rollback and hash-domain separation tests.

units.title: Editor shell and essential formatting
units.scope: Build shared React/TypeScript ProseMirror editor, navigation outline, keyboard shortcuts, autosave, local undo/redo, basic type styles, tables, links and mode indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: Author can draft and print a basic legal document; pending save and failed sync are visible; adopted text remains read-only outside governance commands.
requiredTests: Keyboard/editor component tests, paste sanitization, XSS corpus, IME, Unicode and lost-network recovery browser tests.

units.title: Jurisdiction-aware legal numbering
units.scope: Add configurable hierarchy profiles, starting numbers, continuations, reserved/deleted sections, indent/outdent and previewed renumbering with stable semantic IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: US federal default follows section, (a), (1), (A), (i), (I); corporate and state profiles are explicit; renumbering previews dependent references.
requiredTests: Nested numbering goldens including z/aa, Roman limits, pasted lists, reserved numbers, deletion and undo.

units.title: Definitions and cross-reference integrity
units.scope: Store references to target IDs, defined terms, footnotes and citation metadata; surface broken references and affected references on proposed edits.
acceptanceCriteria: Moved clauses retain correct references; deleted or ambiguous targets visibly block finalization until resolved.
requiredTests: Move/delete/merge references, cyclic definitions, citation import and export consistency tests.

units.title: Authorized realtime draft collaboration
units.scope: Integrate Yjs with ProseMirror for draft rooms, authorized WSS, resumable state vectors, server bounds, section subdocuments and encrypted private update envelopes.
acceptanceCriteria: Reconnect and duplicate updates converge; read-only participants cannot submit CRDT edits; revoked users lose room access; draft sync never mutates adopted snapshots.
requiredTests: Concurrent browser sessions, reconnect/replay, oversized updates, unauthorized-room writes, CRDT compaction and memory-budget tests.

units.title: Selection anchors and replacement proposals
units.scope: Anchor selected ranges with block IDs and relative positions plus base digest, exact quote and context. Support insert/delete/replace/move and multi-clause atomic packages.
acceptanceCriteria: Proposal preview shows exact before/after wording; editing proposed wording creates a new proposal revision and invalidates prior ballots.
requiredTests: Unicode selections, overlapping ranges, stale/rebased anchors, text replacement, deleted targets and ambiguous quote tests.

units.title: Governance policy versions and modes
units.scope: Implement immutable policy snapshots, collaboration/public-input modes, absolute or fractional quorum, approval denominators, tie rules, deadlines, minimum deliberation, finality and challenge windows.
acceptanceCriteria: No public-input write path can change canonical text; rules and mode cannot change during an active vote; open-public electorates use published support floors and participation safeguards.
requiredTests: Boundary tables for strict majority vs at-least supermajority, abstentions, empty electorate, timezone cutoffs and all mode mutation paths.

units.title: Frozen electorates and eligibility evidence
units.scope: Build snapshot eligibility/weight services, verified-person cohorts, invitations, constituency and organization adapters; preserve evidence references without public PII.
acceptanceCriteria: Ballot weight is derived from the frozen electorate; duplicate person credentials cannot vote twice within a scoped cohort; membership changes require a new ballot snapshot.
requiredTests: Sybil/replay scenarios, concurrent snapshot creation, eligibility expiry, cohort partition totals and PII disclosure tests.

units.title: Durable ballots and verifiable receipts
units.scope: Persist one active ballot per eligible principal/proposal revision, replacements with history, signed receipts, idempotency keys, monotonic sequence and transactional outbox.
acceptanceCriteria: Retries cannot create extra weight; acknowledgments happen only after database commit; vote replacement and close races have deterministic ordering.
requiredTests: Double-submit race, write failure, process crash after commit, idempotency collision and exact-integer weighted tally tests.

units.title: Decision closure, deadlines and challenges
units.scope: Implement scheduled/threshold closure policies, official vs provisional tallies, ties, appeal/fraud holds and deterministic decision certificates binding all inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Only final eligible decisions can authorize adoption; a crash or retry cannot close twice; challenged snapshots cannot silently resume with changed voters.
requiredTests: Clock boundary, two closers, fraud exclusion/reopen, certificate recomputation and delayed worker tests.

units.title: Atomic adoption and conflict management
units.scope: Serialize authoritative revision transitions with expected revision checks, proposal/decision bindings, legal schema validation, conflict queues and atomic batch amendments.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the exact voted wording applies once; overlapping accepted proposals cannot silently overwrite each other; changed language returns to deliberation and a fresh vote.
requiredTests: Two simultaneous adoptions, transactional rollback, stale bases, batch atomicity, cross-document injection and private-client verification tests.

units.title: Structured claim graph and evidence
units.scope: Add concise pro/con/clarification claims, evidence links, counterclaims, duplicate merging, bounded graph depth and a clause-linked slide-out panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Each point has one thesis and an editable history; users can inspect strongest points on each side without navigating a chronological comment wall.
requiredTests: Cycle detection, graph pagination, link sanitization, quote evidence integrity, duplicate merge and deleted-claim moderation tests.

units.title: Point voting, rankings and reputation
units.scope: Provide up/down/withdraw point votes, net-score and confidence-based sort profiles, stable tie-breaks, reputation events, anti-ring limits and minority/new-point discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Argument scores never affect legislative voting weight; every ranking explains counts and sort; no secret pay-to-amplify path.
requiredTests: Vote-ring abuse simulations, self-vote rejection, duplicate retries, reputation rollback, deterministic sorting and cold-start exposure tests.

units.title: Moderation, abuse and transparent appeals
units.scope: Implement rate budgets, report queues, brigading detection, appeal records, duplicate proposals, notifications of removals and privacy-aware evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Moderation is visible and auditable; removing a point does not rewrite lawful ballot history; leaked private material can be redacted without false erasure claims.
requiredTests: XSS/spam floods, coordinated flags, moderator privilege escalation, appeal restoration and redacted-export tests.

units.title: Clause-level permissions and selective unlocks
units.scope: Implement organization/document/section capability policies, expiration, read/propose/discuss/vote/sign rights and least-privilege SDK scopes.
acceptanceCriteria: Unlocked clauses are the only amendable targets for each electorate; API, room, search, export, worker and notification paths enforce the same scope.
requiredTests: All-role/all-resource authorization matrix, nested clauses, inherited deny, expired unlock, export leakage and cross-tenant canaries.

units.title: Revision history, redlines and immutable editions
units.scope: Add comparable revisions, authorship/proposal attribution, semantic/text redlines, snapshots, branches, explicit restoration as a new revision and final document states.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can reproduce any adopted edition; signed/final editions never change in place; author-only branch edits cannot bypass votes.
requiredTests: Diff goldens, large edits, history pagination, restoration authorization, signature invalidation and branch/adopted isolation tests.

units.title: Canonical manifests and append-only event log
units.scope: Use a versioned interoperable canonical JSON contract; domain-separated hashes bind document content, policy, electorate commitments, decisions and prior revision; maintain signed log checkpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing any bound input changes its digest; public records include complete reconstructable revision manifests; private commitments are salted and access-controlled.
requiredTests: Cross-language golden vectors, Unicode/number restrictions, event deletion/reorder, divergent histories and restore replay tests.

units.title: Merkle batching and transparency witnesses
units.scope: Create inclusion/consistency proofs, public event sequence commitments, independent witness interfaces and receipt monitoring; batch by size/time.
acceptanceCriteria: A verifier can detect changed history and missing acknowledged receipts; anchoring alone is never described as proof of honest voters or complete history.
requiredTests: Merkle golden vectors, odd/empty batch behavior, forged proofs, split-view and censored-receipt adversarial tests.

units.title: Blockchain anchor provider and finality
units.scope: Implement chain adapters and a durable spend-capped anchor queue, receipt verification, finality depths, reorg handling, fee estimation, archival retrieval and explicit retry states.
acceptanceCriteria: All public documents require periodic and finalization anchors; organizations default off; unavailable chains leave visible pending status and cannot produce a falsely anchored final artifact.
requiredTests: Local chain/provider contract tests, dropped/replaced transaction, reorg, exhausted spend cap, RPC lies and end-to-end receipt verification.

units.title: Independent document verification tool
units.scope: Ship browser and command-line offline verification for revision/package hashes, signatures, Merkle paths, receipts and completeness claims against witnesses.
acceptanceCriteria: A third party verifies an exported edition without trusting the application UI; unknown chain/profile or missing evidence returns unverified.
requiredTests: Independent implementation vectors, modified PDF/content/manifest, stale checkpoint, key revocation and offline-availability tests.

units.title: Safe import and document conversion
units.scope: Add DOCX/ODT/HTML/plain-text import in isolated bounded workers; PDF extraction/OCR produces explicitly provisional drafts with validation previews.
acceptanceCriteria: Import never presents OCR as exact legal text; macros/scripts are discarded; structural and numbering differences are shown before acceptance.
requiredTests: Zip bombs, parser fuzzing, external entity/SSRF, malicious HTML, corrupted packages and legal formatting round-trip fixtures.

units.title: Print, PDF and portable exports
units.scope: Build version-pinned pagination, tagged/bookmarked PDF, PDF/A profile, DOCX, plain text and structured JSON; add covers, line/page numbers, exhibits, watermark and redline export.
acceptanceCriteria: Each export binds exact edition and render profile; exported text/references agree with canonical content; redactions remove underlying data.
requiredTests: Rendered golden pages, extracted-text comparison, accessibility tags, embedded fonts, line wrapping, stale caches and irreversible-redaction tests.

units.title: Signing intent, identities and frozen bytes
units.scope: Add drawn/typed/uploaded signatures, signing order, signer capacity, explicit consent/intent, authentication assurance and cryptographic binding to a frozen edition and artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: Visual marks alone are never treated as identity proof; approval/support signatures and legal execution signatures have distinct intent records; changed text requires a new edition.
requiredTests: Consent/decline, replay, substitution, concurrent signing, private ink access, cancellation, delegation and exact-byte hash tests.

units.title: Mass signature manifests and appendices
units.scope: Build paged readable signature appendices, searchable signer manifests, consented public names, Merkle inclusion receipts and separately hashed appendices for large campaigns.
acceptanceCriteria: Millions of supporters do not require one giant interactive PDF; anyone can obtain a readable page and personal receipt bound to the same frozen text.
requiredTests: Streaming export load tests, signature-order stability, private signer redaction, duplicate signer and manifest/PDF consistency tests.

units.title: Unified typed administration and policy simulation
units.scope: Create one role-scoped admin console and versioned parameter registry for platform/org/document settings, inheritance, change previews, audit, rollback and invariant locks.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can configure product/price/quota/governance settings without code; forbidden weakening and active-ballot rule edits fail closed; effective source of each setting is visible.
requiredTests: Permission matrix, dangerous-setting rejection, concurrent changes, simulations, rollback-as-new-version and audit integrity tests.

units.title: Entitlements, quotas, credits and exemptions
units.scope: Implement grants independent of payments: time subscriptions, one-document purchases, credit ledger, weekly allowances, sponsored public officials, expiration and configurable usage limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Creation atomically reserves quota; a failed creation refunds once; billing changes cannot alter existing voting rights; no automatic charge or unexplained free-official downgrade.
requiredTests: Concurrent credit consumption, weekly boundary, refunds, idempotency, official grant expiry and paid/free policy migration tests.

units.title: Payment provider adapters and reconciliation
units.scope: Add replaceable checkout/provider adapters, signed webhook processing, invoice/tax metadata, grants, subscription lifecycle and credit refunds.
acceptanceCriteria: Verified webhook data maps to idempotent ledger events; public participation remains independent from document-creation purchases; providers are replaceable.
requiredTests: Webhook forgery/replay/order, cancellation, dispute, duplicated checkout, test-mode reconciliation and account isolation tests.

units.title: Guided walkthrough and contextual assistance
units.scope: Connect accessible anchored balloons to real editor, proposal, point-vote, ballot, history, signature and admin controls; role/mode-aware tours with resume and reset.
acceptanceCriteria: Tour targets stay attached on scroll/resize; keyboard and screen-reader equivalents work; walkthrough does not cast real votes or disclose unavailable features.
requiredTests: Browser flows for first-time mobile/desktop, Escape/focus return, zoom, reduced motion, missing target, persisted step and feedback-mode explanations.

units.title: Search, notifications and participation digests
units.scope: Add public/full-text search, private endpoint indexes, subscriptions, notification outbox, verified email preferences, digest controls and topic discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: No private snippets reach operators/search/email vendors; unsubscribes and access revocation take effect before delivery.
requiredTests: Cross-tenant search, encrypted-index boundary, stale notification permissions, delivery retry, unsubscribe and accessibility tests.

units.title: Accessibility, localization and low-bandwidth clients
units.scope: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA target with manual keyboard/assistive checks, plain-language help, localization, bidirectional text and read-mostly low-bandwidth pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Core proposal/discussion/vote/verify flows work without pointer use; accessibility findings are fixed and verification scope is recorded.
requiredTests: Automated axe plus manual screen-reader/keyboard checks, RTL, text scaling, contrast, offline recovery and limited-bandwidth browser tests.

units.title: Public participation scale and hot-document partitioning
units.scope: Partition ballots/claims by proposal and tenant, use immutable CDN snapshots, cursor pagination, bounded rooms, asynchronous projections and reproducible workload benchmarks.
acceptanceCriteria: No document uses an all-participants WebSocket room; authoritative finality remains serialized; measured limits and infrastructure/cost assumptions are published.
requiredTests: Target staged tests: 100 editors, 10k active voters, 1M ballot records, 10M reads/day; queue lag/reconciliation and overload tests at declared hardware budgets.

units.title: Operations, backups and recovery drills
units.scope: Provision isolated Render/Neon resources as authorized, encrypted object storage, bounded workers, observability without content, migration runners and recovery playbooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Restore reconciles revisions, ballots, receipts, keys and anchor outbox; deployment identifiers and health probes bind exact commit; readiness fails on unavailable dependencies.
requiredTests: Migration expand/contract, restore drill, queue failover, key recovery, timeout, storage loss, secret rotation and actual negotiated transport verification.

units.title: Security adversarial review and supply chain
units.scope: Complete source-bound AI security review, threat crosswalk, fuzzing, dependency/static/secret scans, reproducible builds, SBOM and E2EESA evidence by protected flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix concrete findings, preserve scope-specific claims, report unimplemented guarantees honestly; no human audit or certification wait is inserted.
requiredTests: Run current-head full gates, adversarial authorization/collusion/receipt tests, source digest checks and archived tool/configuration reports.

units.title: Federated and delayed-network protocol
units.scope: Define optional sovereign regional instances, discovery and signed snapshot exchange, offline ballots with explicit deadlines, delay-tolerant queues and interplanetary latency simulations.
acceptanceCriteria: No universal instantaneous consensus claim; each document declares an authority/finality domain; remote ballots only count if received under disclosed cutoff rules.
requiredTests: Network partitions, minutes-to-hours delay, conflicting authorities, duplicate federation messages, receipt censorship and disaster resynchronization simulations.

units.title: Extension SDK and release compatibility
units.scope: Publish versioned shared editor/UI/domain/API packages and an OpenAPI/event contract, plugin capability registry, consumer fixtures and rolling compatibility policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Both application repos consume the same engine release; no wrapper forks adoption/crypto/tally logic; incompatible profiles fail explicitly.
requiredTests: Two-consumer contract matrix, old/new schema compatibility, SDK permission bounds, supply-chain provenance and upgrade rollback tests.

units.title: Production candidate and complete release evidence
units.scope: Deploy core services, verify real account/proposal/ballot/adoption/export/sign/anchor journeys and publish operations evidence, known limitations and owner review package.
acceptanceCriteria: Actual production smoke passes for public and private profiles; public-input remains immutable; independent human review is queued only after deployment.
requiredTests: Live multiuser authorization and browser smoke, real configured anchoring finality, restore evidence, load report and exact deployment commit checks.
